toni: quick FYI: customer reported emails showed up in crash-upload logs. looks like iOS SDK background uploads sometimes lose X-Request-Id, so server-side redaction misses entries :grimacing:
evan: steps to repro?
toni: minimal repro in sampleapp-ios. we create a background URLSession upload, put X-Request-Id header on the URLRequest, then toggle airplane mode so OS persists and resumes the task. ~10% of resumed uploads reach server without the header.
priya: can you paste the snippet?
toni: ```swift
var req = URLRequest(url: uploadURL)
req.addValue(requestId, forHTTPHeaderField: "X-Request-Id")
let task = backgroundSession.uploadTask(with: req, fromFile: fileURL)
task.resume()
```
priya: backgroundSession is URLSession with `URLSessionConfiguration.background(withIdentifier:)`, right? OS can serialize tasks and re-create them after app relaunch. some request fields don't roundtrip.
toni: exactly. headers sometimes aren't archived by the system when the task is handed off.
qa-bot: repro run: created demo, enable airplane mode during upload, reopen app, wait for OS resume. server logs: 9/100 missing X-Request-Id. correlated with redaction-missed-count metric.
ops-bot: alert: redaction-missing-count +120 spikes at 07:23 UTC -> paging sent.
evan: for short term, can we avoid leaking by default? e.g., change release logger default to .info and strip verbose PII debug logs in SDK builds.
toni: we already flipped debug->info in a recent canary, helped a bit but still need request-id fix for correctness.
priya: short-term workaround: encode request id in the URL query param `?req_id=` because the URL is preserved by the OS for background tasks. ugly but reliable.
evan: ugly but pragmatic. long-term we should persist a wrapper for background tasks that re-creates the request with headers on resume, or include a small persisted metadata blob the native runtime will re-attach.
priya: also evaluate trace propagation headers like `traceparent`/`b3` — some of those might be preserved in background tasks depending on how the session is created. if server redaction can fallback to trace id mapping that could help.
toni: server-side followup: if no X-Request-Id, try fallback lookup using traceparent or x-b3-traceid before skipping redaction, and emit metric so we can track.
evan: action items: 1) toni open sampleapp PR adding `?req_id=` fallback + integration test that simulates background resume; 2) priya spike persistent wrapper and test traceparent preservation across background sessions; 3) evan add server heuristic to lookup trace header fallback and a metric for missing-request-id.
toni: I'll open PR and add notes to the sampleapp README about background-session header caveat. will include reproduction script.
priya: also adding a short doc blurb recommending SDK users avoid shipping DEBUG logs in release builds and how to set logger defaults.
evan: thanks — assigning followups in Jira. quick reminder: any change that adds request id to URL needs to be validated so we don't accidentally cache or leak ids in logs or CDNs.
toni: good call, will include that validation in tests. TL;DR: background URLSession tasks can drop headers; short fix = URL param fallback + logging level defaults; long fix = persistent wrapper or OTEL trace propagation support. :lock: :white_check_mark:
